_doc: Things waiting for the user to watch, listen to or decide. The dashboard shows them first, with players. Agents: add an item whenever you need the user's eyes or ears; never ask them to open files in GitHub or chat. Remove (or set status: done) once decided, and record the decision in docs/DECISIONS.md. kind: audio | video | image. files: repo paths.

items.title: Three methods, one Short: which way do we make videos?
items.question: Same script, voice, facts and music, three different ways of making the picture. A = art-directed paper (the Emu War's craft made into rules: one palette, one hero per beat, every object a lit illustration, a recurring local character, designed paper props for every number). B = a 3D paper miniature (the real coastline in relief with real shadows, one continuous camera from street level to the 1846 continent). C = kinetic infographic (night map, glowing lines, big moving type, one dot per person). Tell me which one, or which parts of each. My bet is A's characters + B's map flights + C's big numbers. Full write-up: docs/research/methodology-3-versions-2026-10.md (These players are 540p previews so they load fast on a phone; the 1080p masters are in the Media library and in each variants/<a|b|c>/out/ folder.)

items.title: Action: replace the OpenRouter key (the old one was exposed)
items.question: The key was pasted into the vault file as plain text in a public repo (commit 18a5b52), so treat it as public. 1) openrouter.ai → Keys → delete that key, create a new one. 2) On your laptop: $env:STUDIO_VAULT_KEY = "<vault key>"; "<new key>" | python studio\tools\vault.py set OPENROUTER_API_KEY  3) Upload studio\vault.enc.json to GitHub (studio folder). Never paste a key directly into the file.
